_doc: Revert-verify mutants for issue #4353 — SPARQLErrorEnhancer's two prefix readers. The issue's table named `extractUnknownPrefix`; M2 guards `extractDeclaredPrefixes`, which feeds the SAME diagnostic sentence — leaving it on `\w+` makes the fixed reader name a prefix and then omit it from 'Available prefixes'.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/cli/src/utils/SPARQLErrorEnhancer.ts

M1_unknown_prefix_narrow._note: Pre-fix extractUnknownPrefix: `(\w+)` stops at the hyphen, so the message blames 'tbank' — a prefix the query never used.

M2_declared_prefixes_narrow._note: Pre-fix extractDeclaredPrefixes: `PREFIX\s+(\w+):` never matches a hyphenated declaration, so a prefix the query DOES declare is missing from 'Available prefixes' and from the did-you-mean candidates.
